programs.name: pswigp
programs.purpose: Plot binary floating-point traces as a PostScript wiggle plot with optional fills, axes, and curves.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSWIGP - PostScript WIGgle-trace plot of f(x1,x2) via Polygons

params.name: n1
params.description: Number of samples in the fast dimension.

params.name: d1
params.description: Fast-dimension sample interval.

params.name: f1
params.description: First fast-dimension sample coordinate.

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: number of x2 values if supplied; otherwise input file size in floats divided by n1
params.description: Number of traces. Required for a non-seekable input unless x2 is supplied; x2 takes precedence over n2.

params.name: d2
params.description: Trace coordinate interval, used only when x2 is absent.

params.name: f2
params.description: First trace coordinate, used only when x2 is absent.

params.name: x2
params.description: Trace coordinates; its number of values determines n2.

params.name: bias
params.description: Value subtracted from each sample when supplied and nonzero; when omitted no subtraction is performed.

params.name: perc
params.description: Percentile used to determine clip when clip is absent.

params.name: clip
params.default: computed: absolute-value sample at clamped index int(n1*n2*perc/100) after bias subtraction
params.description: Symmetric clipping magnitude.

params.name: xcur
params.description: Absolute wiggle excursion in trace spacings; scaled by the displayed axis-2 span divided by the number of included traces minus one when more than one trace is included.

params.name: fill
params.description: Wiggle fill and shading mode.

params.name: linewidth
params.description: Trace line width in points.

params.name: tracecolor
params.description: Trace color.

params.name: backcolor
params.description: Plot background color; none leaves it unfilled.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print the clip value to stderr when nonzero.

params.name: xbox
params.description: Left offset of the axes box in inches.

params.name: ybox
params.description: Bottom offset of the axes box in inches.

params.name: wbox
params.description: Axes box width in inches.

params.name: hbox
params.description: Axes box height in inches.

params.name: x1beg
params.default: computed: minimum of f1 and f1+(n1-1)*d1
params.description: Beginning axis-1 coordinate, subsequently snapped to a sample.

params.name: x1end
params.default: computed: maximum of f1 and f1+(n1-1)*d1
params.description: Ending axis-1 coordinate, subsequently snapped to a sample.

params.name: d1num
params.description: Numbered axis-1 tick interval; zero selects automatic spacing.

params.name: f1num
params.default: computed: minimum of f1 and f1+(n1-1)*d1
params.description: First numbered axis-1 tick.

params.name: n1tic
params.description: Axis-1 tick subdivisions per numbered tick.

params.name: grid1
params.description: Axis-1 grid style: dot, dash, solid, or none.

params.name: label1
params.description: Axis-1 label.

params.name: x2beg
params.description: Beginning axis-2 coordinate.

params.name: x2end
params.description: Ending axis-2 coordinate.

params.name: d2num
params.description: Numbered axis-2 tick interval; zero selects automatic spacing.

params.name: f2num
params.description: First numbered axis-2 tick. The selfdoc says x2min, but the code initializes it to zero.

params.name: n2tic
params.description: Axis-2 tick subdivisions per numbered tick.

params.name: grid2
params.description: Axis-2 grid style: dot, dash, solid, or none.

params.name: label2
params.description: Axis-2 label.

params.name: labelfont
params.description: Axes label font.

params.name: labelsize
params.description: Axes label font size.

params.name: title
params.description: Plot title.

params.name: titlefont
params.description: Title font.

params.name: titlesize
params.description: Title font size.

params.name: titlecolor
params.description: Title color.

params.name: axescolor
params.description: Axes color.

params.name: gridcolor
params.description: Grid color.

params.name: axeswidth
params.description: Axes line width in points.

params.name: ticwidth
params.description: Tick line width in points.

params.name: gridwidth
params.description: Grid line width in points.

params.name: frame
params.description: Draw axes and title when nonzero.

params.name: style
params.description: normal makes axis 1 horizontal; any other value selects seismic orientation.

params.name: curve
params.description: ASCII files containing x1 x2 coordinate pairs for overlay curves.

params.name: npair
params.description: Number of coordinate pairs per curve file. Required for safe curve plotting, but the code does not check that it was supplied or has enough values.

params.name: curvecolor
params.description: Colors for overlay curves; missing trailing values repeat the last supplied color.

params.name: curvewidth
params.description: Widths for overlay curves; missing trailing values repeat the last supplied width.

params.name: curvedash
params.description: Dash indices for overlay curves; missing trailing values repeat the last supplied index.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Clip selection uses float absolute values and qkfind; percentile index calculation mixes integer and floating-point arithmetic. Coordinate scaling, bias subtraction, rounding to sample indices, and the PostScript plotting routines depend on floating-point evaluation and formatting. Zero or degenerate dimensions and scales can cause division by zero or invalid accesses. When curve is supplied without enough npair values, uninitialized array entries are used; curve-file fscanf results are also unchecked.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers a full float grid, selects a percentile, maps coordinates, and draws filled wiggles and optional overlay curves through the PostScript library.

test_cases.description: Default seismic orientation with percentile clipping on piped binary samples.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sustrip | pswigp n1=128 n2=16 verbose=0 > wiggle.ps

test_cases.description: Normal orientation with explicit clipping, bias, negative fill, colors, and grid.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip | pswigp n1=64 n2=8 d1=0.004 f2=10 d2=2 clip=0.8 bias=0.1 fill=-2 style=normal grid1=dot grid2=dash backcolor=white tracecolor=blue verbose=0 > normal.ps

test_cases.description: Infer trace count from a seekable file and plot a cropped region without a frame.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip > in.bin && pswigp n1=64 d1=0.004 x1beg=0.04 x1end=0.20 x2beg=2 x2end=6 perc=90 xcur=0.5 fill=0 frame=0 verbose=0 < in.bin > cropped.ps
